title: 線形代数学（再履修クラス）
subtitle: Linear Algebra
courseType: Mathematics and Science ProgramMathematics and Science Courses
educationalGoal:
Students will learn
(1) vector operations and matrix operations.
(2) solving systems of linear equations using “row reduction.”
(3) transformations in physical or data spaces using matrix operations.
(4) the properties of a determinant and a method to calculate determinants.
(5) eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
advice:
This is a basic course in linear algebra. We will cover the following topics:

1. Vectors and Matrices
2. Systems of linear equations and row reduction
3. Linear transformation
4. Determinants
5. Linearly independence
6. Eigenvalues and eigenvectors

Daily preparation and review are important. Students are required to complete the designated tasks.
Students are required to show their solution/calculation procedure logically and clearly in each assignment.
Students are expected to utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the teacher.
books:
Textbook：Linear Algebra [KIT Mathematics, Science, Data Science and AI Programs]
Reference book：：A First Course in Linear Algebra (Open Textbook Library)[Lyryx]
requiredKnowledge: Basic computational skills for mathematical expressions (calculation of literal expressions, linear and quadratic equations, trigonometric functions) and knowledge of coordinate planes.

activityGoals.body: Understand the concept of vectors and matrices, and be able to properly perform operations.
Understand the concept of systems of linear equations by using row reduction.
Understand the properties of determinants and be able to calculate the value of a determinant.
Understand the concept of linear transformations and be able to find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
Understand the meanings of fundamental English words for mathematics.
Understand the contents of the course and be able to complete the required tasks by the announced deadlines.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Perform properly vector operations and matrix operations.
(2) Solve “complex” linear systems using row reduction.
(3) Understand the concept of linear transformations and properly determine representation matrices.
(4) Understand the definition and properties of determinants and be able to calculate determinants.
(5) Understand the properties of cofactors and find inverse matrices.
(6) Find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of matrices and apply them to diagonalization.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Perform vector operations and matrix operations.
(2) Solve “fundamental” linear systems using row reduction.
(3) Find representation matrices of linear transformations in a plane.
(4) Understand the properties of determinants and be able to calculate determinants.
(5) Find inverse matrices using cofactors.
(6) Find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of simple matrices.
